study: D5: transient amplification and viscous decay of a Kelvin wave
units: dimensionless; lengths in L_ref, time in T_ref, speed in L_ref/T_ref, viscosity in L_ref^2/T_ref

scope.background: U=(S*y,0), an unbounded affine Couette flow
scope.averages: uniform phase average; also x average over a full kx period at fixed y
scope.boundary: exact unbounded-plane solution; snapshots show a window, not periodic walls in laboratory coordinates
scope.energy: perturbation phase-averaged kinetic energy per unit mass; not total whole-space energy
scope.heat_reference: same initial perturbation with zero background shear and the same viscosity
scope.physical_conversion: multiply reported wavelength by L_ref for dimensional wavelength; no fluid or physical anchor is assigned
scope.numerical_time_integration: independent fixed-step RK4 of the projected two-component amplitude equation
